system.description:
Named Unique (rapier +2). Once per round, out of turn, when a creature in your reach hits you with a melee attack, make one attack against it.

Quirk (Jealous): its power sleeps for a round after you use another weapon. Won in a Lankhmar tavern duel and lost a dozen times since; every owner talked better than they fenced.

Monsters & Treasure, Named Uniques. Saves use DC 10 + half your level + the attribute named.
